witness.quote: No person shall park a vehicle in an access aisle.
witness.reason: Public-access premises support a parking target within a constructed qualifying aisle.
required_context: Establish contrasting spaced, crosshatched or diagonal stripes or a distinctive paving-material change.
Establish designated adjacent space and accessible-route connectivity.
Establish jurisdiction, vehicle scope, responsible person and unresolved NRS-definition applicability.
Establish marked aisle extent and parking footprint within or adjoining the premises.
If designation relies on LVMC 11.52.135(A), preserve the access-symbol, minimum-fine wording or equivalent, and sign-bottom height of at least four feet.
Realize aisle extent adjacent to a parking space designated for the handicapped, its vehicle ingress and egress function and accessible-route connection.
Record vehicle classification, responsible person, occupancy, loading purpose and activity, and jurisdiction.
Retain parking footprint, motion, occupancy, purpose and actual loading activity without assigning a boundary-overlap or temporary-standing cutoff.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can personally perform the covered parking activity.
